family.$description: Font stacks. Figma uses Source Sans Pro for all UI text and Poppins for titles, tabs, KPI numbers and wordmarks; Source Sans 3 is the maintained version of Source Sans Pro (decision D17). Each web font is followed by its metric-matched fallback (a local Arial resized to the same metrics, generated by scripts/generate), so nothing moves when the web font arrives. Noto Sans Thai covers the Thai translations neither family has. Inter, Geist and Lato appear in Figma only inside library parts and the cover, and are not product fonts.

weight.$description: Weights used in the final screens (ExtraLight and Light appear on tooltips and the round timer).

text.$description: Font sizes with their default line heights, the sizes the final Figma screens use. 15 px (md) is the Figma form label and button size. Display roles override the line height with leading.display.

tracking.$description: Letter spacing. Figma sets 0.5% on almost every Source Sans and Poppins style (normal), -1% on the KPI pill labels (tight) and 1.2 px on the 10 px overline (wide).

leading.$description: Unitless line heights. Figma sets Poppins titles to 'auto': Poppins' own line spacing with its line gap, 1.5 times the size (a 30 px title sits in a 45 px box, 24 in 36, 18 in 27; measured on the final screens).
